message:
Yen receipts now render correctly: `renderReceipt({ amount: 500, currency: 'JPY', method: 'card' })` gives `Paid ¥500 by card`. Both receipt tests pass when I run the test file directly with `node`.

`node --test` hangs in this environment, both for the full suite and for the single receipt file. It timed out even with a 60s limit, so I couldn't get a normal runner pass. I didn't investigate why it hangs, and I didn't run the rest of the suite.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divided every amount by 100 and added two decimals, so 500 yen showed as `¥5.00`. Yen has no minor unit.

**Fix:** I added a small zero-decimal currency set containing `JPY`. For those currencies `formatMoney` prints the amount as-is.

This helper is shared by invoices, cart and admin, so yen amounts there will now also show without decimals. Nothing else in the repo references JPY, so I don't expect other tests to be affected.
